description.fun: Magnemite looks like a modern machine, all magnets and screws, yet carvings of it have been found in the ancient Ruins of Alph. It floats on the electromagnetic waves from the magnets on its sides, and even sleeps in mid-air. Since power lines went underground, it raids power plants instead, so the plants send out signals Magnemite can't stand to keep it away.
description.guide: A small, floating Electric and Steel Pokémon with a round metal body, one eye, three screws and a horseshoe magnet on each side. Its magnets let it defy gravity, and it feeds on electricity. It was a pure Electric type until Generation 2 and evolves into Magneton, then Magnezone.
description.tagline: A floating magnet with one eye and three screws

description.fun: Magneton is three Magnemite stuck together by a magnetic force so strong it dries up all moisture and raises the temperature by 2°C for a kilometre around. Three times the electric power doesn't mean three times the brains, though. It turns up more often when sunspots flare, and gathers on high ground where lightning strikes when thunderclouds form.
description.guide: The evolution of Magnemite, made of three Magnemite linked by a strong magnetic force. It is an Electric and Steel Pokémon (pure Electric before Generation 2) that floats using anti-gravity and gives off magnetism that disrupts electronics. It evolves into Magnezone in a special magnetic field or with a Thunder Stone.
description.tagline: Three Magnemite stuck together: triple the power, not the brains

description.fun: Magnezone flies through the night sky like a UFO, sending and receiving signals from an unknown source, so some people believe it came from outer space. It actually forms when Magneton is exposed to a special magnetic field that changes its molecular structure, something scientists have never managed to force. Its shape may come from a legendary tea kettle that, the story goes, was packed with gunpowder and blown up.
description.guide: The final stage of Magnemite's line, introduced in Generation 4, a UFO-like Electric and Steel Pokémon formed from Magneton. It evolves when Magneton is levelled up in a special magnetic field or exposed to a Thunder Stone. It floats using anti-gravity and sends out mysterious signals.
description.tagline: A magnetic flying saucer some think came from space

otherWays: Level up, at Blush Mountain, Vast Poni Canyon, New Mauville, Route 13, Chargestone Cave or Mt. Coronet
